<!-- pr-reviewer: 1b080d4202cda0ae6cc6bec3d318b37830c0ed40 -->

Not merge-ready yet: the two items from the last round are satisfied, but the branch conflicts with `main` and needs a refresh.

**Verdict**: do not merge yet. Clean review of this head; orange `conflicts` label. The author resolves the `SKILL.md` conflict and re-pushes; the review re-runs then.

**What looks good**

- Both old names stay hidden aliases in one generic table (`crates/app/src/posting_aliases.rs`). Project loading, option-key normalizing, `SelectPost`, `SetSetupPost`, `resolve_cps`, the offer and the machine post check all call it. No generic module names the post.
- The new `agie_native::legacy_name` test opens each old-name project and posts it with no per-run option override, compares `CCSEP20.ISO`, `CCSEP20.SBR` and `CCSEP20.SBL` byte for byte with the unchanged goldens, and checks that a save writes the new name.
- The 11 changed `.refusal` goldens change line 2 only; the job goldens do not change. No production text is changed except the rename and the refusals; no geometry, collision or post-output behaviour changes.
- `Process change: yes` is present; `PROCESS_VERSION` is not edited. `Fixes #4000` and the `Changelog:` line are present.

**The two items of the last round (028530986)**

1. Screenshots — satisfied. The body carries five before/after pairs (post list, post dialog, per-op refusal, status line, wire page hint). All ten images load from the fork branch `pr-screenshots`, folder `pr-4022/`. The body states before is `origin/main` 3bb6647f6 and after is the PR head. The PR branch carries no images. The folder picker title is a native window and is stated as not harness-renderable.
2. Legacy-project post test — satisfied. `crates/app/tests/agie_native/legacy_name.rs:32` posts each old-name project, compares the three job files byte for byte with the goldens, and checks the save's new name. The `wire_post_alias` round-trip now says only what it does (open and save), and the decision file records why the posting test lives in the `agie_native` suite.

**Trial merge**

This head vs `origin/main` 267ee5096 does **not** merge cleanly. The conflict is in `.claude/skills/camcraft-mcp/SKILL.md`, one hunk: the Wire Contour row. `main` (#4002, #3991) added `lead_arc_radius` to that row; this branch renamed the post in that row. All other files auto-merge. The reviewer does not resolve it; the author refreshes the branch.

**Tests run at the head (local, this worktree, CAMCRAFT_GATE_JOBS=6, CAMCRAFT_NO_SCCACHE=1)**

- `wire_post_alias`: 6 passed (all six pins, incl. the renamed round-trip)
- `agie_native` (full suite, incl. `legacy_name`): 38 passed
- `script_agie_native` (the 11 changed refusal goldens): 11 passed
- `plasma_post_refusals`: 7 passed
- `conformance`: 7 passed
- `comment_escape`: 4 passed
- `mcp_wire_contour` (the SKILL.md pin): 9 passed
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post -p camcraft-geometry -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings`: exit 0 (app/post/geometry from a fresh build; ui checked clean, exit 0)

P7, not under the safety floor: no heavy lane is owed. No example catalog, `light` or ui lib suite was run by choice of scope; the ui lib/egui_app suites were not run here (headless host; the earlier review recorded the same three host failures on bare main).

**Requested before merge**

1. Refresh the branch with `git merge origin/main` (never rebase, never force-push). Keep both sides of the `SKILL.md` hunk: `main`'s `lead_arc_radius` (#3991, #4002) and this PR's rename of the post in the same row (`"Agie Wire EDM (AgieVision)"`), and the `mcp_wire_contour` SKILL.md pin must stay green. Re-run the targeted tests after the refresh and push.

**Notes (not blocking)**

- After the refresh, a fresh collaborator review at the new head is required. The current review and the `merge-ready`-class state do not transfer.
- The body says the ui `#[test]` count does not go down; not re-verified here.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
